description: A collection of 4 production-ready .NET console application templates with progressive complexity: Simple (manual DI), Standard (Generic Host + BackgroundService), Advanced (extension methods pattern), and Enterprise (strongly-typed configuration). Features: async/await support, Serilog logging, Docker containerization, database access (EF Core/Dapper with SQLite/SQL Server/PostgreSQL), typed HTTP clients with Polly resilience, health checks, message queuing (RabbitMQ/Azure Service Bus/Kafka). Supports .NET 8.0 (LTS), .NET 9.0 (STS), and .NET 10.0 (LTS, latest).
title: Inflop Console Application Templates
